items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: A guy named Gene Harris. And I thought wow, that’s really great. I’m going to go see him.

ctx.x: There’s that Big Bill Broonzy moment all over again.

Yeah. Oh absolutely. And you know I never got to see him live. Never. But he was live on the radio. You know? It was almost. And there are a lot of people I regret. I mean there’s this jazz piano player I heard on the radio once when I shouldn’t have been listening to the radio. A guy named Gene Harris. And I thought wow, that’s really great. I’m going to go see him. So I wrote his record company and I said could you tell me where he’s going to be? Would you put me on his mailing list. I’ve got all these frequent…
